Immortal Fire

Immortal Fire is one of Agni's unique transcendental skills that allows him to relocate to anywhere there is an active flame or fire. It is just like teleportation, except for the fact that there must be fire at his destination.

Agni can move as far as his summoners vigor allows far beyond his line of sight , so if he gets caught in a difficult situation, he can move very far away and regenerate, thus the name Immortal Fire. However, the greater the distance traveled, the more difficult it is on his summoner. Since the distance depends on the amount of vigor the summoner has left, he is careful not to overuse this skill. Therefore, Agni tries to get an idea of how far he can move with this skill, based on his summoner's vigor, before he must resort to other transcendental skills in order to avoid reducing his summoner's lifespan.

During the times when Agni was able to use this skill on his own without the limitations of a summoner, he was one of the gods who could move among the stars the quickest.

Plot
Agni uses this transcendental multiple times in the webtoon.

Near the end of the attack on Atera, Agni uses this skill on the resulting fires from his earlier use of Nine Snakes of Hell as he searches for Sagara.[1]
Agni uses this skill to travel quickly from Atera to Kalibloom, where Gandharva is rampaging in his sura form. He appears in a fire at the Temple of Earth that someone was in the process of putting out.[2]
Agni uses this skill again to travel quickly from Atera to Kalibloom, where Gandharva and Maruna were sighted. Since Chandra turned off all the fires in the city in order to stall him, Agni appears in a torch carried by a reformed thief outside the city.[3]

Insight

You know how the older you get, and the more you experience, the broader your sight becomes? If you live a thousand years, a million, over a billion… longer than you can even remember…

– Agni to Leez

Insight shows what is hidden. It is a transcendental skill (see Note below) that reveals to the user the emotions and thoughts of a target, the target's past or future, or a sura's non-transformable body parts (which shine brightly) in their human form.[2]

It is not a passive skill, so the user has to decide to read a target. If a user attempts to view a target's emotions, they could occasionally view a glimpse of their past or future in a fantasy-like setting; it cannot be controlled. The user must be experienced in this skill, and if the target is of a similar age to or older than the user (such as a nastika-level sura), the skill does not work. But even if the user is unable to view a nastika's emotions, they can still recognize their sura body parts.

With the exception of Yuta, the user must make and maintain eye contact for the skill to work, assuming the target is younger than the user.
Any future revealed by insight is not predetermined and can potentially change, as evidenced by God Kubera's insights on Leez.[3]
Information obtained through the use of insight cannot be retrieved a second time through insight, only orally or in writing.[4]
Vishnu, Kali, Yuta, and Taraka are known to have a superior form of insight:

Vishnu is capable of seeing all paths of the future at any time, although doing so is believed to have affected his mind.
Little is known of Kali's insight. In the finite, she is mentioned to have insight similar to Vishnu. Gandharva also revealed that Vishnu and Kali did not have ordinary insight.[5] Kali actively lies about the information she gains to further her own goals; Vishnu is later revealed to lie for his own gain as well.
Yuta's insight allows him to read the thoughts of anyone younger than him even without eye contact.[6] It is possible that he can also see pasts/futures.[7]
The true extent of Taraka's insight is not clear. Yuta claims that the information she gets is distorted,[8] but Agni has stated that her insight skill is exceptional.[9] Yuta's point of view is likely due to the fact that he sometimes erases unpleasant things from his memory, so his claim is unreliable as a result.
Knowledge of insight is unknown to humans unless a god has revealed it to someone directly.[10] The following humans are aware it exists:

Asha Rahiro learns of it from Vishnu when he visits her on Carte in the year N5.[11]
Kasak Rajof knows of it, as well as the fact that he possesses information that cannot be retrieved by insight a second time.[4] It is strongly implied that he learned about it from Vishnu, who spent time with him when he was a child.
Claude Yui reveals to Chandra that he knows about insight, but does not reveal which god told him.[10]
Agni describes insight to Leez Haias simply as the broad perspective of someone who has lived a very long time and experienced many things.[1]
Note
Currygom admitted in the Episode 32 afterword that she only listed insight among Agni's transcendentals so that she could publish his list of transcendentals. (Her personal rule for releasing a character's transcendentals list is that there has to be at least five, and Agni had only four at the time.) She was vague as to whether or not insight was an actual transcendental.[12]

Vishnu's earrings

These earrings are a god-level item created by Vishnu to help his friend Taksaka regain some emotions through the suppression of his sura traits and the indifferent nature that characterizes the Vritra clan.

Characteristics
The earrings created by Visnu are a pair of round red earrings that made it possible to hide sura traits and suppress certain mental characteristics of sura origin.

Despite their suppressive power, they cannot alter a sura's eating habits.[2] They also do not allow suras to fool the sura sensors of city checkpoints.

Notes
They do not allow sura to bypass the city barriers created by Brahma.
Normally, god-level items share the regenerative properties of the god, but the earrings did not restore themselves and are destroyed permanently.[3]
Plot
Taksaka was the original owner of the earrings, given to him by Vishnu in Mistyshore.[4] Many years later, the earrings were later handed down to Taksaka's son, Kasak Rajof, after his mother's death. When Yuta approached him to ask for a way to remain with Leez Haias and Asha Rahiro, Kasak loaned him the earrings.[1] Yuta later has to apologize for being unable to return them.[5]

Normally, the earrings suppress Yuta's sura traits including his sharp teeth. However, in the water channel, the earrings broke, possibly due to Taraka's influence, thus making them useless.[6]

It is revealed that Kasak's family members, Meiwen and Agwen both believe that the earrings created a fake personality for Kasak and that they hid his true face, that of a monster.

Shorten Distance is a transcendental skill that allows the user to reach a visible location quickly.

The user must have a spot to step upon at the destination, and that spot must be connected to the location where the user is standing. For example, the user can move to the rooftop of a building in a single step, but they cannot move to a floating object.

Sinkhole is one of God Kubera's unique transcendental skills. It causes the earth to sink. It is similar to the normal transcendental Earthquake, which is embedded in the Golden Knight, but while Earthquake leaves behind the remains of the destroyed land, Sinkhole completely removes it. Where the missing earth goes is a mystery.

Natural sinkholes are created when underground water erodes the earth underneath the surface, causing the surface to collapse; however, the theory behind this transcendental skill is completely different.

Plot
Once God Kubera decides that Leez has the potential to use the bracelet properly, he gets rid of the suras still remaining after her trial-by-fire lesson using Sinkhole, creating a giant crater with no visible bottom.

Destructive Breath

Destructive Breath is a fire- and destruction-aligned unique transcendental skill of the Vritra clan.

Breath is a unique transcendental of all Vritra clan nastikas; however, the effect of Breath depends greatly on the source attribute. Most forms of Breath show fire or lightning effects, but Destructive Breath (also known as invisible fire)[1] has no visible effects at all, making it even more dangerous and harder to dodge.

At the moment, the only beings with matching attributes are the nastika Taksaka and a half of his bloodline, Kasak Rajof.

The Breath transcendentals do not necessarily need to be fired from a dragon's mouth, but the attack is more powerful and quicker that way.[2]

Notes
Taksaka is able to destroy stars with his Breath alone.
The strength of the Breath transcendental was the cause for the penalty that the Vritra clan received. See also: Vritra Clan

During the second sura attack on Atera, Kasak uses this attack after gauging the strength of the Ananta clan suras. Riagara refers to his skill as invisible fire. This attack causes Hura's first death of the night, after which Riagara orders Hura to use its Transcendental Trap in order to redirect all future attacks from Kasak to itself.[1]

In a flashback, Taksaka uses his Breath to puncture holes in nearby mountains in order to demonstrate that he is more powerful in human form than Vasuki is in any form. Vasuki complains that he fights for hierarchy even with those from different clans.[1]

Kasak later fires a weaker version of this attack from his hand while Maruna had his mouth clamped shut. Maruna dodges quickly thanks to his natural high speed, so Kasak barely clips his left wing.

Bloody Line

Bloody Line is a darkness transcendental skill that cuts in an area where the user is looking at.

Among the darkness-attribute transcendental skills, this transcendental has one of the highest required transcendental values. Therefore, it is usually only used by nastika. Although it is very useful in human form in a quite narrow range, since the range increases proportionaly to the body size, it's by far more powerful when used in sura form.

Hand gestures are usually used with this skill (more out of habit than anything else) but are not essential. Although the skill can be blocked physically, used on living creatures, Blood ignores the defense and cuts.

Nuclear Fusion

Nuclear Fusion is a fire general transcendental skill that has been mentioned as one of Agni's most destructive abilities throughout Kubera's storyline.[1] Like its namesake that births fiery suns, it is a powerful transcendental that can cause an explosion capable of melting whole planets.[2]

Nuclear Fusion cannot choose which target to affect and which to spare, damaging the ground zero's surroundings without discrimination. Due to this indiscriminate nature, Agni tends to avoid using Nuclear Fusion near a planet even when it can end a fight quickly and he is not restricted by a summoner.[1]

Its main user is Agni though it's not Unique to him.

Currygom said that Kubera could have ended with Nuclear Fusion accidentally destroying the entire planet Willarv if Agni did not care for his summoner's safety who provides his vigor.[2] Agni himself is the source of all fire in the realms, including the fire of suns and even the Big Bang during the Beginning,[3][4] whose flame Agni had to absorb at the dawn of the universe's creation to cool down the universe.[4]

Because it is a general transcendental, it can be used by anyone who knows the skill and has enough vigor to use it. According to Currygom, it is one of the few general transcendentals that is more powerful than a Unique Transcendental.[5] It's rare for a general transcendental to be more powerful than a unique one.

Potential sura and human users
In the year D875 a fire nastika self-destructed to cause an explosion that destroyed the galaxy he lived in.[6] The shockwave traveled so fast that it killed an untold number of suras despite them using water channels to evacuate to another galaxy and having advanced news of its approach. The entire galaxy disappeared along with them, the trauma of it causing Clophe to suddenly advance to the 3rd stage during evacuation.

Lorraine Rartia tried to kill Asha Rahiro using the self-destruct feature of a presumed nuclear fusion car as a makeshift bomb to stop Ananta's resurrection ritual.[7] Being a Triple-A creation magician, Lorraine could make powerful magic items imbued with the transcendental magic of various attributes. Her car's explosion destroyed everything in a 10-km radius. Brilith suggested to Agni that he check out the bomb site as "this is what [he would] know best".[8] While investigating it, Agni agreed the site of the explosion "felt so familiar" to him that he did not notice anything was amiss at first. Brilith considered it a relief that the current humanity has not yet developed this technology into (nuclear) weapons, as they would become weapons powerful enough to pose a threat to nastikas and gods again that would have provoked another preemptive action like what befell ancient humanity.

When not in its normal form (sword/belt), it will glow.[2] The precise requirements for unsealing it and its powers are so far unknown.

Skills
Gladiator of Light
The Gladiator of Light[4]

Conditions: Unknown

This skill is originally a transcendental used by Nastikas who have light as their source attribute; it's a skill that absorbs weapons and stores them inside the body, and they can be taken out and used in a light form when needed. The basic attack/defense performance of the weapons is almost completely maintained, but detailed form and transcendental functions they had before being absorbed disappear. Currently, Yuta is not using this transcendental skill himself, but uses an item: This weapon, which usually takes on the form of a stick wrapped in black cloth (2nd stage Yuta, belt in 3rd stage), has actually the form of a sword. It was passed down from Garuda to Maruna to Yuta. It seems there are quite a few weapons stored within it, but the forms Yuta can activate are so few that they can be counted on one hand.

Among the weapons Yuta can wield in the fights during the Test of the Sword, the most unique is a throwing spear, which can only be used when it's not in his hand. It may seem strange at first to throw with a weapon that has already missed its target, but this is just a problem caused by Yuta not handling this weapon properly; Originally, it is a throwing spear that can set up to 8 target points and attack at the same time. However, since Yuta is only able to designate a target point of the spear as himself, this function can only be used to retrieve a weapon that has been lost or to attack nearby enemies. At the time when he fought Riagara, Yuta would have inflicted damage to himself due to the weapon targeting himself, but fortunately, the weapon does not deal damage towards the creature designated as its current owner.

Notes
Sagara took the sword for a god-class Item[6]. It is not known whether this is true, especially in light of the information that Nastikas can create Items out of their body parts as well. In case it is a god-class item, the likely creators are Kali or Vishnu, going by Garuda's past affiliations.
History

Although the precise details of the sword's creation is unknown, nastikas such as Garuda can create weapons by removing a piece of their body to be used for source material. The only condition the nastikas need to adhere to is to refrain from regenerating the wound the weapon was made from.[7]

The sword was handed down from Garuda to Maruna and then to Yuta, the current owner. Among the many functions of the weapon is also the one to hide transcendental value. And since Maruna knew how to hide his transcendental value on his own, he gave the sword to Yuta.[4]

The uncovered sword was first seen being held by Yuta just after he attacked a group of humans, consisting of a Half hunter and his customers, who had killed a Gandharva Half in cold blood.[8] The sword was briefly handed to Leez to protect an unknown person in their party from the Hide of Bondage,[9] but was later given back.

Yuta showed the item's full capability when he intervened in a fight between God Kubera and Sagara. Yuta intended to capture Sagara to eat her using the chain form, but she escaped by cutting off her own foot.

Priest

A Priest (Hangul: 신관; RR: sin-gwan; lit. god conduit) is a pure-blood human or quarter with triple attributes (and high divine affinity), entrusted with special duties.

Overview
A priest's characteristic is a strong sense of responsibility towards the city they protect. (Claude Yui, Priest of Death, is an exception...) Brilith Ruin and Teo Rakan have been shown to be willing to fight to the death for their city and its inhabitants, even against enemies they know they cannot defeat.

Most priests are also high-ranking magicians (AA or A). A priest usually lives in the temple he/she is responsible for; Teo Rakan, Priest of Chaos, is an exception.

Duties:

maintaining a barrier
lots of paperwork
having weight in important decisions (e.g. trials, magician meetings, organization of the city)
giving blessings to the crowd in front of the temple on the specific hour of the attribute the temple is aligned to

Some priests have more than one occupation, such as Teo (+ Fighter Guild Branch President), Saha (+ Eloth Magic Guild Branch President + Presiding Judge of Magic + Chancellor of Eloth University) and Laila (+ Rindhallow Magic Guild Branch President).

Priest candidates
Temples usually have backups for the priest, called priest candidates, to operate the barrier during times when the priest is sleeping, absent, or incapacitated.[1][2] It is likely that a priest candidate would succeed a priest upon his or her death.

Agwen Rajof and Natasha Ross were both priest candidates in Atera before leaving to become professors in Eloth. Claude frequently has a priest candidate in his place at his temple since he often avoids his temple duties.

Notes
For female priests, it is considered "unsightly" to have lovers (although male priests seem to be fine). Brilith's mother was considered an exception because she was already married when she became a priest.
There seem to be "open temple" events in the month of the temple attributes, at least for the Temple of Chaos.
It is likely that the position of priest only came into existence after the creation of the barriers (some time after D0).
History
Enan Reimia, a human fighter, was chosen by God Kubera to wear the Golden Knight and become the first Priest of Earth.[3][4]

In D914, Varuna was present in Mistyshore; the summoner was a very young boy. She stayed until at least D920. Laila Hemawati's mentor and predecessor summoned Chandra in the year N0 but died because the god was still unaware of the new restrictions and used his powers recklessly, depleting his priest's lifespan.

Ran's aunt, Eline Haias was the Priest of Resurrection before the destruction of the Temple. [5] She was #3 on the planet before N0, triple-Visnu, and married to Huan Sairofe (Priest of Water), also in Mistyshore.

Trisilla Ajes, the Priest of Wind from Carte, summoned Vayu and used all her remaining lifespan to protect the ship transporting the survivors from Carte to Willarv in N5.

Lorraine Rartia was supposed to become Priest of Creation, but she fled Eloth and left Lutz Sairofe to become the priest although he flopped his exams to avoid becoming a priest.

Jibril Ajes, the previous Priest of Fire and Brilith's mother, summoned a god in N5, which greatly shortened her lifespan. Natasha Ross was originally Jibril's successor,[6] but due to Brilith's summoning of Agni after her mother's death (which caused her to appear to create a perfect barrier), Brilith became her successor instead.[7]

Talith Ruin, Brilith's father, was a candidate for the Temple of Destruction in Atera, before its destruction in N0.[5] He summoned Marut in N5, depleting his lifespan.
